![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

Starting a full Vite server instance inside a unit test (`beforeAll`) is a heavy operation that can significantly slow down the test suite, consume excessive resources, and potentially cause port conflicts or flakiness in CI/CD environments.

Instead of spinning up a Vite server to load the React components via `ssrLoadModule`, consider configuring Jest to handle JSX and asset imports directly (e.g., using `@swc/jest` or `babel-jest` along with `identity-obj-proxy` for CSS/assets) so that components can be imported statically. Alternatively, if the project is Vite-based, migrating the test suite to **Vitest** would allow native support for Vite's configuration and imports without the overhead of manually managing a server instance.

Fixed in `96059bb3f`. The formula security test no longer starts Vite or uses `ssrLoadModule`; it is now a plain Jest source-contract test plus direct renderer fallback classification coverage. Local verification passed for `math-rendering.test.js`, `paper-workspace-formula-text-security.test.js`, and `paper-workspace-pr4-math-rendering.test.js`.
